missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Государство' is neuter nominative as the subject of 'помогает'. 'Своим гражданам' is the dative object, showing whom the state helps.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Государство' is neuter accusative, identical to the nominative here. It is the direct object of 'любим', and 'наше' agrees in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Государства' is the genitive form showing whose law it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the neuter genitive, modifying the noun.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Государству' is the dative form after 'служит', which governs the dative. 'Своему' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. 'Государством' is the instrumental form naming the agent in this passive construction. The army is run by the state.

missions.phrase: В нашем государстве живут разные народы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В государстве' uses the prepositional form 'государстве' to express location. 'Нашем' agrees in the neuter prepositional.

missions.phrase: Многие государства входят в этот союз.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Государства' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'входят'. 'Многие' agrees in the plural, naming several countries.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Государств' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Небольших' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with adjective. 'Государство' is neuter nominative as the subject. 'Сильное' is the agreeing neuter adjective describing it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Государства' is the genitive form required after 'без'. The question asks whether life is hard without a state.
